rationale.intervention_reconstruction: The hypothesis uses a hybrid thermo-mechanical route (cryogenic rolling + warm rolling), while the target uses a high-pressure high-temperature (HPHT) treatment. These are fundamentally different kinds of interventions.
rationale.condition_agreement: The hypothesis specifies cryogenic rolling and warm rolling at ~600°C, whereas the target uses 6 GPa pressure at 1473 K for 2 hours. These are entirely different processing regimes with no overlap.
rationale.mechanism_agreement: The hypothesis invokes refined interfaces, serrated boundaries, and back stress to blunt microcracks, while the target relies on coherent interfaces enabling dislocation transfer and hierarchical deformation modes. These are different mechanistic classes.
rationale.outcome_agreement: Both predict simultaneous improvement in strength and ductility, but the hypothesis is vague about magnitude and the target specifies a doubling to ~1150 MPa and ~36% elongation. The direction is the same, but the specifics differ.
